title: Majisthadi Churna
description: Majisthadi Churna (Manjisthadi Churna) is formulated with Indian Madder (Manjistha), the ultimate systemic cooling blood cleanser for skin and circulatory health. This classical formulation detoxifies blood by removing accumulated impurities. Clears deep cystic acne through improved circulation and toxin elimination. Reduces skin hyperpigmentation (dark spots) through blood purification. Purifies lymphatic flow supporting comprehensive detoxification.
